William Faulkner, As I Lay Dying.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-faulkner/as-i-lay-dying

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Faulkner, the author, died 1962.

First publication of the text used: 1930 (SE colophon: 'As I Lay Dying was published in 1930 by William Faulkner.'; first edition released October 6, 1930, by Jonathan Cape and Harrison Smith, a United States edition, per Wikipedia)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1930, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below), and a work published in 1930 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 2026.
- Country of origin: the United States. The first publication was in the United States, before 1931, so the United States rule settles the country of origin whatever the death year. The author died in 1962, which would matter only for a country other than the United States, and this text does not need one.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
